interpretations: Group `player_college` by `college_id`, treating all NULL college IDs as one group, and count distinct non-NULL `player_id` values in each group. Select groups whose count is strictly greater than the average count across all groups. Return one unrounded row containing the selected groups’ average count, their average share of the sum of all group counts, and their average count minus the all-group average.
queries:
WITH college_counts AS (
    SELECT college_id, COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) AS player_count
    FROM player_college
    GROUP BY college_id
),
all_groups AS (
    SELECT AVG(player_count) AS avg_count,
           SUM(player_count) AS total_count
    FROM college_counts
)
SELECT AVG(c.player_count) AS avg_count,
       AVG(1.0 * c.player_count / a.total_count) AS avg_share,
       AVG(c.player_count) - a.avg_count AS avg_count_difference
FROM college_counts AS c
CROSS JOIN all_groups AS a
WHERE c.player_count > a.avg_count
